name: devads
description: Turn developer wait time into value. Sponsored cards during builds, installs, and tests you were already waiting on -- never before, never longer.

devads.enabled.description: Show sponsored cards during long-running terminal commands.

devads.minimumWaitSeconds.description: Only consider showing an ad after a command has been running at least this long. Commands that finish sooner never show an ad.

devads.videoAdsEnabled.description: Allow video creatives. (v1 status bar surface renders image/card creatives only; this is reserved for future richer surfaces.)

devads.categories.description: Only show ads from these categories. Leave empty to allow all categories.

devads.categoriesOptOut.description: Never show ads from these categories.

devads.adServerUrl.description: DevAds ad server URL. Set to http://localhost:4000 for local development.

devads.webAppUrl.description: DevAds web dashboard URL, used for the dashboard link and DevAds' own offer walkthroughs. Set to http://localhost:3000 for local development.

devads.telemetryEnabled.description: Send coarse, allowlisted context (language, framework, runtime, platform, country) with ad requests. Never sends source code, file contents, environment variables, secrets, or full command arguments.

devads.sponsorship.enabled.description: Show sponsored offers that carry a developer reward (for example AI or API credits) during long-running terminal commands, and keep a DevAds development session open while signed in. Offers only appear when devads.enabled is also on, and your DevAds account opt-in is still enforced by the server. Sends only this extension's client type and version plus session and offer ids. Never sends source code, prompts, file paths, or command lines.

scripts.package: npm run build && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o devads-0.1.0.vsix
